contentPattern.structure: image + title + description + CTA per slide

suitableFor: carousels with prominent per-slide text and call-to-action panels
full-width image galleries where each slide promotes a linked destination
notSuitableFor: image-only banner carousels with no per-slide text (use carousel-hero)

distinctFrom.carousel-hero: carousel-hero is the adventure-detail 'mini' variant: fixed 400px full-bleed image-only slides with no text/CTA panel. carousel-teaser adds an overlaid per-slide content panel (heading + description + CTA), matching the WKND homepage cmp-carousel--hero.
